text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Word was that Hishi Amazon would enter the 
Japan Cup. Meanwhile, Machikane Tannhauser 
was set to run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
right before it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Compared to her past formidable foes, this 
race draws slightly less attention. 
However, Narita Brian never lets her guard 
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide praises her as she toils in 
her training. Hearing her speak as an 
observer rather than a fellow runner, 
Narita Brian felt a sense of unease.
